column1: #   claim_type          — must match an id in cmmn_config.yaml claim_types
#   severity_threshold_high     — estimated_damage above this → HIGH severity
#   fraud_score_flag    — fraud_score at or above this triggers SIU_REFERRAL
#   auto_approve_limit  — damage_estimate at or below this → auto-approve (no human review)
#   sla_warning_pct     — % of max_days_to_resolve at which an SLA warning fires
#   sla_breach_pct      — % of max_days_to_resolve at which an SLA breach is raised
#   reserve_multiplier  — damage_estimate × multiplier = initial financial reserve
#   escalate_supervisor_on_override — true/false: supervisor alert if adjuster overrides auto decision
